question: What span of the Śrīcakra is delineated from the earth-enclosure up to the bindu?
premises: The earth-enclosure is named as the starting point.
The bindu is named as the endpoint.
The sequence is addressed to the great goddess.
inference: The Śrīcakra is to be understood as extending from the outer earth-enclosure to the central bindu.
uncertainties: The exact ritual or contemplative action implied by this span is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: O great goddess, beginning from the earth-enclosure and extending up to the bindu.
